detailed_description: Online Countdown Timer is a feature-rich timing tool that supports custom hours, minutes, and seconds. Provides common preset times like 1 minute, 5 minutes, 10 minutes, 15 minutes, 30 minutes, and 1 hour for quick one-click setup. During countdown, displays a beautiful circular progress bar showing remaining time ratio. Sends browser notification when countdown ends (requires permission). Supports pause, resume, and reset functions. Perfect for Pomodoro technique, cooking timing, break reminders, and more.
usage_steps: Open the Countdown Timer tool page
Select a preset time or manually enter hours, minutes, seconds
Click the green 'Start' button to begin countdown
Watch the circular progress bar for remaining time
You'll receive a notification when countdown ends
usage_examples: Set cooking times for eggs, noodles, etc.
Break reminders to get up and move
